findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "bsc_pool_scan" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "bsc_pool_scan" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "preflight" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bsc_pool_scan · Private data: bsc_token_preflight, bsc_pool_scan · Public sink: bsc_pool_scan · Destructive: bsc_token_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bsc_pool_scan · Private data: bsc_token_preflight, bsc_pool_scan · Public sink: bsc_pool_scan · Destructive: bsc_token_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
